verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover all three distribution routes in the story. It is in Claude Code's official marketplace (`claude plugin install mattpocock-skills@claude-plugins-official`). Codex and Copilot can install it through their plugin marketplaces. `npx skills add mattpocock/skills` writes editable skill files into the project repo, which can be committed and updated on demand with `npx skills update`. missing for 10: explicit team-rollout guidance (e.g., committing installed files or pinning a shared version across a team), independent or hands-on corroboration of the install paths.
